[{"id": 111, "tag": "P039_2", "raw": "Stryver sucked the end of a ruler for a little while, and then stood hitting a tune out of his teeth with it, which probably gave him the toothache.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 112, "tag": "P039_3", "raw": "He broke the awkward silence by saying:", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 113, "tag": "P040_1", "raw": "“This is something new to me, Mr.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 114, "tag": "P040_2", "raw": "Lorry.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 115, "tag": "P040_3", "raw": "You deliberately advise me not to go up to Soho and offer myself--_my_self, Stryver of the King’s Bench bar?”", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 116, "tag": "P041_1", "raw": "“Do you ask me for my advice, Mr.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 117, "tag": "P041_2", "raw": "Stryver?”", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 118, "tag": "P042_1", "raw": "“Yes, I do.”", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 119, "tag": "P043_1", "raw": "“Very good.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 120, "tag": "P043_2", "raw": "Then I give it, and you have repeated it correctly.”", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}]

[{"id": 121, "tag": "P044_1", "raw": "“And all I can say of it is,” laughed Stryver with a vexed laugh, “that this--ha, ha!--beats everything past, present, and to come.”", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 122, "tag": "P045_1", "raw": "“Now understand me,” pursued Mr.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 123, "tag": "P045_2", "raw": "Lorry. “As a man of business, I am not justified in saying anything about this matter, for, as a man of business, I know nothing of it.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 124, "tag": "P045_3", "raw": "But, as an old fellow, who has carried Miss Manette in his arms, who is the trusted friend of Miss Manette and of her father too, and who has a great affection for them both, I have spoken.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 125, "tag": "P045_4", "raw": "The confidence is not of my seeking, recollect.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 126, "tag": "P045_5", "raw": "Now, you think I may not be right?”", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 127, "tag": "P046_1", "raw": "“Not I!” said Stryver, whistling. “I can’t undertake to find third parties in common sense;", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 128, "tag": "P046_2", "raw": "I can only find it for myself.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 129, "tag": "P046_3", "raw": "I suppose sense in certain quarters;", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 130, "tag": "P046_4", "raw": "you suppose mincing bread-and-butter nonsense.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}]

[{"id": 131, "tag": "P046_5", "raw": "It’s new to me, but you are right, I dare say.”", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 132, "tag": "P047_1", "raw": "“What I suppose, Mr.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 133, "tag": "P047_2", "raw": "Stryver, I claim to characterise for myself--And understand me, sir,” said Mr.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 134, "tag": "P047_3", "raw": "Lorry, quickly flushing again, “I will not--not even at Tellson’s--have it characterised for me by any gentleman breathing.”", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 135, "tag": "P048_1", "raw": "“There!", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 136, "tag": "P048_2", "raw": "I beg your pardon!” said Stryver.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 137, "tag": "P049_1", "raw": "“Granted.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 138, "tag": "P049_2", "raw": "Thank you.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 139, "tag": "P049_3", "raw": "Well, Mr.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}, {"id": 140, "tag": "P049_4", "raw": "Stryver, I was about to say:--it might be painful to you to find yourself mistaken, it might be painful to Doctor Manette to have the task of being explicit with you, it might be very painful to Miss Manette to have the task of being explicit with you.", "en": "", "ko": "", "is_header": false}]
